title: ADR-020: Payments webhooks are signed with HMAC-SHA256
text:
Status: Accepted. Date: 2026-09-01.
Decision
All outgoing webhooks are signed with HMAC-SHA256 using a per-partner secret, sent in the Tally-Signature header. We rejected mutual TLS because partners found certificate rotation too hard.
Consequences
Secrets rotate every 90 days.
note: "Secrets rotate every 90 days" is a defensible second decision

title: ADR-003 (old): Use Redux for all state
text:
Status: Superseded by ADR-005 on 2026-06-17.
Decision (2025-03-10): We use Redux for all client state, including server data.

title: 2026-11-10 Architecture review
text:
Attendees: Platform, Payments, Risk.
Notes
- Risk wants faster fraud scoring.
Decisions
1. Fraud scoring stays synchronous inside the transfer request; we will not move it to an async queue because a transfer must not commit before scoring.
2. Scores are cached for at most 60 seconds in Redis.
3. We will re-evaluate a dedicated fraud service in Q2 2027.
Action items
- Benchmark scoring latency (Risk).

title: ADR-021: 고객 알림은 카카오 알림톡으로 발송
text:
상태: 승인됨. 날짜: 2026-10-05.
결정
고객 알림(송금 완료, 정산 완료)은 카카오 알림톡으로 발송한다. SMS는 비용이 높아 알림톡 실패 시 대체 발송에만 사용한다. 푸시 알림 단독 사용은 앱 미설치 고객 때문에 기각했다.

title: Proposal: adopt Temporal for workflows
text: Status: Proposed (not yet agreed). We propose adopting Temporal for long-running settlement workflows. Discussion scheduled for 2026-12-01.

title: Coding conventions
text: Use black for formatting. Use ruff for linting. Type hints are required on public functions. Prefer dataclasses over dicts for structured data.

title: ADR-022: No ORMs in the reporting service
text:
Context: reporting queries are complex and hand-tuned.
Decision: the reporting service uses raw SQL through psycopg; SQLAlchemy ORM is not used there. The ledger service keeps SQLAlchemy.
Status: accepted 2026-07-21.
